# origincloud_network_floating_ips (Data Source)

Lists the floating IPs in a zone, oldest first, those the platform assigned at launch included.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project whose floating ips to list.
- `zone` (String) The zone whose floating ips to list.

### Read-Only

- `floating_ips` (Attributes List) The floating ips listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--floating_ips))

<a id="nestedatt--floating_ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `floating_ips`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) The public address.
- `auto_assigned` (Boolean) Whether the platform assigned the address at launch, to an interface the launch created in a subnet with `auto_assign_public_ip`. Such an address is released when its instance is terminated.
- `create_time` (String) When the floating IP was created. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `creator` (String) The principal that created the floating IP, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`; empty for one the platform created.
- `name` (String) The floating IP's resource name.
- `network_interface` (String) The network interface the address reaches, as the floating IP's association (a `FloatingIpAssociation`) sets it; empty while it has none.
- `private_address` (String) The interface's private IPv4 address the public one translates to, as the floating IP's association sets it; empty while it has none.
- `tags` (Map of String) Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows.
- `urn` (String) The floating IP's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use.
